points.title: Real effectiveness rule
points.problem: The factory can count ritual as progress.
points.required_behavior: Separate product/material progress from process ritual; done counts only when product outcome advances or executable repair is created.

points.title: Universal automatic repair loop
points.problem: Blockers can become passive or negative closeout.
points.required_behavior: Every factory-owned blocker loops repair -> audit -> rerun -> reconcile until resolved or true external/human authority remains.

points.title: Interactive factory start/discovery OS
points.problem: Factory start can be too mechanical and under-aligned.
points.required_behavior: Gerente-led discovery captures intent, scope, non-goals, UX, architecture preview, access/capability needs, risks and success criteria before material execution.

points.title: Hermes environment preflight
points.problem: Factory starts without proving Hermes environment readiness.
points.required_behavior: Run doctor/preflight for profiles, bindings, skills, toolsets, browser, computer use, terminal/file/web, cron, gateway, PDF/video/media, domain providers and access readiness.

points.title: Gerente as proactive manager
points.problem: Gerente is not yet a proactive human relationship manager.
points.required_behavior: Gerente owns status, asks, summaries, progress and artifact delivery; cron/watchdog wakes gerente, not human directly.

points.title: Human UX / artifact quality
points.problem: Human can receive raw technical dumps.
points.required_behavior: Human-facing gates/status use PDF/equivalent and video where configured/requested; JSON/Markdown are internal evidence only.

points.title: Architecture approval gate
points.problem: Material execution can start without operator-readable architecture approval.
points.required_behavior: Present architecture PDF/optional video with system shape, tradeoffs, rejected alternatives, boundaries, integrations, security, costs and operations before material execution.

points.title: Domain-specialized capability requirement
points.problem: Generic agents can handle specialized domains without capability proof.
points.required_behavior: Mandatory capability/provider registry per domain; Solana/onchain requires Solana AI Kit or approved official Solana capability before generic execution.

points.title: Quality firewall
points.required_behavior: Definition of Excellence per critical artifact; lazy/generic artifacts fail and route to repair.

points.title: Real progress metric
points.problem: Done counts are not meaningful to the human.
points.required_behavior: Report product percent and critical path by gates/artifacts/readiness, not raw task counts.

points.title: Hard boundary between plan/proof/ready/release
points.problem: Bounded evidence can look like readiness.
points.required_behavior: Plan, spec, bounded proof, report-only pass, QA pass, release readiness, production readiness and Receipt Five are distinct machine states.

points.title: Capability acquisition lane
points.problem: Missing tools/providers can stop the factory instead of acquisition.
points.required_behavior: Missing factory-acquirable capabilities create acquisition/eval/smoke/promotion path before human block except true external authority.

points.title: Worker accountability
points.problem: Bad workers can keep being trusted.
points.required_behavior: Track worker quality, failure and rework; demote or route review/repair when repeated poor output occurs.

points.title: Public/private/security boundary automation
points.problem: Safety boundaries rely on humans remembering rules.
points.required_behavior: Automated checks for secrets, private paths, raw internal artifacts, Mainnet/funds/signing/custody boundaries and human artifact leaks.

points.title: Adaptive system, not blind linear phase rail
points.problem: F1..F27 can become a dumb conveyor.
points.required_behavior: Phase graph supports lateral loops, re-entry, blocker-specific repair lanes, and downstream gating on reconciliation.
